entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:1
segments: ¶By night on my bed I was looking for him who is the love of my soul: I was looking for him, but I did not see him.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:2
segments: I will get up now and go about the town, in the streets and in the wide ways I will go after him who is the love of my soul: I went after him, but I did not see him.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:3
segments: The watchmen who go about the town came by me; to them I said, Have you seen him who is my heart's desire?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:4
segments: I was but a little way from them, when I came face to face with him who is the love of my soul. I took him by the hands, and did not let him go, till I had taken him into my mother's house, and into the room of her who gave me birth.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:5
segments: I say to you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes of the field, let not love be moved till it is ready.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:6
segments: ¶Who is this coming out of the waste places like pillars of smoke, perfumed with sweet spices, with all the spices of the trader?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:7
segments: ¶See, it is the bed of Solomon; sixty men of war are about it, of the army of Israel,

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:8
segments: All of them armed with swords, trained in war; every man has his sword at his side, because of fear in the night.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:9
segments: King Solomon made himself a bed of the wood of Lebanon.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:10
segments: He made its pillars of silver, its base of gold, its seat of purple, the middle of it of ebony.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:11
segments: Go out, O daughters of Jerusalem, and see King Solomon, with the crown which his mother put on his head on the day when he was married, and on the day of the joy of his heart.
